name: Exp_RSI_Histogram
summary: This EA trades based on the RSI Histogram custom indicator, opening buy positions when the histogram crosses above the low level zone and sell positions when it crosses below the high level zone. It uses configurable money management modes, fixed stop loss and take profit, and processes signals on new bar formation to avoid redundant trading.
summary_zh: 该EA基于RSI Histogram自定义指标进行交易，当直方图从低位区域向上穿越时开多仓，从高位区域向下穿越时开空仓。它支持可配置的资金管理模式、固定止损止盈，并在新K线形成时处理信号以避免重复交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于RSI直方图指标的动量交易。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区2的值为0（表示RSI处于低位区域）且缓冲区0的值大于0时，产生买入信号；当缓冲区2的值为2（表示RSI处于高位区域）且缓冲区0的值小于2时，产生卖出信号。出场条件通过反向信号触发，即持有多仓时遇到卖出信号则平多仓，持有空仓时遇到买入信号则平空仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于扣除亏损后的可用保证金、基于扣除亏损后的余额、以及固定手数模式。止损和止盈使用固定点数设置，分别为1000点和2000点。信号处理仅在新区间形成时或首次加载时执行，避免同一K线内重复开仓。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is momentum trading based on the RSI Histogram custom indicator. Entry conditions are: when indicator buffer 2 equals 0 (RSI in low zone) and buffer 0 is greater than 0, a buy signal is generated; when buffer 2 equals 2 (RSI in high zone) and buffer 0 is less than 2, a sell signal is generated. Exit conditions are triggered by opposing signals — a long position is closed when a sell signal appears, and a short position is closed when a buy signal appears. Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Stop loss and take profit use fixed point values of 1000 and 2000 points respectively. Signal processing only executes on new bar formation or initial load, preventing duplicate entries within the same bar.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，控制每笔交易的风险比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter controlling risk percentage per trade or fixed lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算模式，支持可用保证金、余额、扣除亏损后的可用保证金、扣除亏损后的余额、固定手数五种模式
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode: free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, or fixed lot

parameters.name: RSIPrice
parameters.description_en: Price type used for RSI calculation

parameters.name: HighLevel
parameters.description: RSI高位阈值，用于判断超买区域
parameters.description_en: RSI high threshold for overbought zone detection

parameters.name: LowLevel
parameters.description: RSI低位阈值，用于判断超卖区域
parameters.description_en: RSI low threshold for oversold zone detection

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的K线索引，0为当前K线，1为前一根已收盘K线
parameters.description_en: Bar index for signal retrieval; 0=current bar, 1=last closed bar

pros: 使用已收盘K线信号（SignalBar=1）避免重绘问题，信号更可靠
支持五种资金管理模式，灵活性高，适应不同风险偏好
新K线检测机制避免同一K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易
买卖开关可独立控制开仓和平仓，策略配置灵活
止损止盈比例1:2，具有正期望收益的风险管理结构
pros_en: Uses closed bar signal (SignalBar=1) to avoid repaint issues, making signals more reliable
Supports five money management modes offering flexibility for different risk preferences
New bar detection prevents duplicate entries within the same bar, reducing overtrading
Independent buy/sell switches for opening and closing provide granular strategy control
Stop loss to take profit ratio of 1:2 provides a positive expectancy risk management structure
cons: 依赖自定义指标RSI_Histogram，该指标需单独安装且不在标准库中
止损1000点和止盈2000点固定设置，未考虑市场波动性（如ATR）动态调整
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利入场
缺少持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓
指标加载失败时仅打印日志但EA仍继续运行，可能导致无信号交易
cons_en: Depends on custom RSI_Histogram indicator which must be installed separately and is not in the standard library
Fixed stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points do not adapt to market volatility (e.g. ATR)
No spread filter which may lead to unfavorable entries in high-spread environments
Lacks position existence check which may cause duplicate entries in the same direction
Indicator handle failure only prints a log but EA continues running, potentially trading without signals
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自动调整止损止盈距离
添加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓
在指标句柄无效时应在OnInit中返回INIT_FAILED停止EA运行
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to automatically adjust distances based on market volatility
Add position existence check to prevent duplicate entries in the same direction
Return INIT_FAILED in OnInit when indicator handle is invalid to stop EA execution instead of continuing

risk_points: 指标加载失败时EA不会停止运行，可能在无信号状态下持续执行
缺少持仓检查，存在同方向重复开仓风险
固定止损未考虑市场波动性，低波动时止损过大，高波动时止损过小
risk_points_en: EA does not stop running when indicator handle fails, potentially executing without signals
No position existence check creates risk of duplicate entries in the same direction
Fixed stop loss does not account for market volatility — too wide in low volatility, too tight in high volatility

summary_en: This EA trades based on the RSI Histogram custom indicator, opening buy positions when the histogram crosses above the low level zone and sell positions when it crosses below the high level zone. It uses configurable money management modes, fixed stop loss and take profit, and processes signals on new bar formation to avoid redundant trading.
